chunks: Had he not been one of those who struggled hard,

key_terms.الْمُسَبِّحِينَ: Those who glorify God; those who strive in worship and praise

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Al-Musabbiheen' mean in the context of Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah As-Saff (61:7) is often interpreted as a rhetorical question or conditional clause emphasizing that if the Israelites had recognized Musa (AS) as one of the *Mussabbiheen* (those who constantly glorify God), they would have accepted his prophethood. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that spiritual purity and constant remembrance (*dhikr*) are key indicators of divine truth, linking the Israelites' failure to their lack of deep spiritual insight rather than just the absence of miracles.
